Text.CaptureCard:
1. In WindowResizer, select BPSR and set 500 top × 2000 bottom.
2. In the guild center photo menu, select the custom background.
3. Resize the window to 500 × 5680, set scale to 20%, and confirm.
4. Move the capture to the top, set scale to 100%, move it up and down a couple of times, then leave it at the top.
5. Press V to take the photo. Return the window to 1920 × 1080 and confirm the photo.
Text.CapturePortrait:
1. In WindowResizer, select BPSR and set 545 × 2152.
2. In the game, place the image at the top and press V to take the photo.
3. Return the window to 1920 × 1080 and confirm the photo.

Text.ManualGuide:
Manual capture guide
====================

Joseleelsuper.png is 1500x2500 and can be used for Card/Dungeon.
Portrait/Chat requires a 1500x1500 PNG:
  .\BPSR-ImageChanger.ps1 -Action prepare -ImageType portrait -ImagePath <image.png>

1. Run prepare and use PKGcontrol with the files in work; the steps are saved in
   work\PKGcontrol-pasos.txt.
2. Close the game. In PowerShell as administrator, run:
   .\BPSR-ImageChanger.ps1 -Action install
3. For Card/Dungeon, open WindowResizer as administrator, select BPSR, and set
   500 (top) x 2000 (bottom). In the guild center photo menu, choose the background;
   resize to 500 x 5680 and set scale to 20%; move the capture to the top, set 100%,
   move it up and down a couple of times, leave it at the top, then press V.
4. Return the window to 1920x1080 and confirm the photo.
5. Close the game and run as administrator:
   .\BPSR-ImageChanger.ps1 -Action restore

The script does not change the resolution or close the game. install and restore
will not modify m92.pkg while BPSR_STEAM.exe is running.
